changes: ⚠️ BETA — this is the last beta before the next stable release. Do NOT install or update a live / production server with this build. Use a dedicated test server only.

Ministra / MAG portal: channel, category and genre field types now follow the Stalker contract exactly. The adult-lock PIN, favourites star and timeshift / record icons no longer show on every channel and category, categories can be selected again on native STB firmware, and removing or reordering a favourite no longer drops the wrong one.

Load balancers (BREAKING): the legacy /api link — an unenrolled node reaching MAIN's database and Redis with the stream password — has been removed; every node now uses the cluster API (mode 2). A load balancer still below mode 2 must be re-provisioned (ADR 0004).

Modules: a module is shown by its module.json title; store modules are found and updated from the store catalogue; a broken module no longer takes the panel down, and quarantined module files are fingerprinted with sha256.

Created channels: VOD and EPG support for created channels, with a dedicated 'Created Channels' EPG source; fixed the on-demand native-remux fallback and created-channel handling on cluster-API (mode 2) nodes.
cron:series refreshes a created series channel's sources again (the refresh was silently skipped before) and signals the change only after the database write succeeds.
VOD import: series import locks use an advisory file lock, so a slow import no longer has its lock cleared out from under it by a waiting worker.
CLI: the status constants the panel's services return are defined in every boot context, so a command-line path that reaches one no longer aborts with an undefined-constant error.
Import & Review: an m3u row without an EPG id no longer logs a warning on import.
Panel and load-balancer updates can ship as X.Y.Z-pN patch builds without a full release (consolidates 2.6.6-p1 … p6).
